headline: SCKit ScreenConnect worm now top story (9 outlets); Check Point PHP2Shell and UnrealIRCd KEV due 11-16; N-central zero-day

bullets.text: New: Microsoft details SCKit abusing ScreenConnect to deploy remote access and target technician sessions; the worm-like malware aimed at MSPs is now the top story at 9 outlets. Dark Reading reports the ArcticRAT gang uses AI to profile victims' finances.

CISA added Check Point CVE-2026-123039 (PHP2Shell) and UnrealIRCd CVE-2026-114713 to KEV on 11-13, federal due date 11-16. Attackers use the Check Point flaw to gain root, plant a TSGA backdoor and wipe VMware ESXi. No fixed release version is on the board.
N-central (PoC, 5 outlets): the N-able zero-day was exploited hours after a PoC; 21 servers infected, 19 on Hotfix 2, so patched servers are not safe.

Breaches: City of Osaka (1 million people), Uber (drivers' license data), TSMC (employees, via a cloud provider), 144,000+ Norwegian and Widerøe passengers, Apify, UT Arlington. Trezor confirms implants in CryptoBilis-sold wallets and released a fix. German military drone operations were disrupted.

Law enforcement disrupted Gootloader, CastleRAT and StealC infrastructure; DOJ ties Gootloader to 44+ ransomware attacks costing $29M. FBI says North Korean hackers stole $400M+ in crypto via deepfake video calls. SilentAir intercepts SMS 2FA codes in Asian mobile networks.

Still active: Apache httpd CVE-2026-119618, SignDrop Windows SYSTEM zero-day, Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320. KEV due 11-24: BroadWorks, Openwave CVE-2026-111793, Outlook CVE-2026-124194, Chromium CVE-2026-125350. Last 7 days run 1.26x the 90-day average.

actions: ScreenConnect: inventory instances and extensions, review technician sessions and hunt for SCKit remote-access deployments using Microsoft's guidance.
Check Point: apply the vendor fix for CVE-2026-123039 before 11-16, restrict gateway management access, hunt for TSGA backdoors and keep ESXi backups offline.
UnrealIRCd: patch or take internet-facing servers offline for CVE-2026-114713 before the 11-16 KEV due date.
N-central: treat servers as exposed even on Hotfix 2; take consoles off the internet and hunt for new admin accounts and unexpected agent commands.
Trezor users: apply Trezor's fix and treat recovery phrases on CryptoBilis-sourced wallets as exposed.
Patch Apache httpd for CVE-2026-119618 and queue BroadWorks, Openwave, Outlook and Chromium before 11-24.
